Completion evidence for the externally evidenced `make verify` acceptance criterion:

- Gerrit change 3002, revision `0c56a96aafaedc2f7399ff4e15fc0d6499f665df`, received `Verified +1` from the CI bot for the gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell.
- Gerrit submit returned `MERGED`; the merged commit on `origin/main` is `d08a0a373a36c89fd0c6f3df0e566d3fedfa27d5` (`d08a0a373a3`).
- Local full `make verify` was intentionally not run on this macOS arm64 host because `pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 `pandoc`, causing 17 unrelated pandoc tests to fail with `Bad CPU type in executable`.
- Targeted tests ran from an extracted `d08a0a373a3` tree because the shared checkout differs from the merged revision; repo venv was on `PATH` and the extracted tree's `src` was pinned on `PYTHONPATH`.
- `tests/unit/test_fixture_heal_heldout.py::test_production_attempter_creates_heal_work_dirs_before_manifest_write tests/unit/test_fixture_heal_heldout.py::test_production_attempter_runs_agentic_admission_inside_gate_read_root`: `2 passed in 0.58s`.
- `tests/unit/test_fixture_heal_heldout.py::test_production_attempter_creates_heal_work_dirs_before_manifest_write`: `1 passed in 0.46s`.
- `tests/unit/test_fixture_heal_heldout.py::test_production_attempter_runs_agentic_admission_inside_gate_read_root`: `1 passed in 0.42s`.
